_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a farmer, entrepreneur, or member of SHG. 1. The applicant belongs to General, SC, ST categories, SHG members, PWD, Women, and Transgender individuals. 1. The applicant should purchase two Graded Murrah She Buffaloes, preferably in their 1st or 2nd lactation and yielding a minimum of 8 liters of milk per day. 1. If the applicant is a PwD, their disability should be more than 40%. 1. An individual per family will be eligible to avail assistance only once.
